test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper made a loss of 150 on an article. If the loss percentage was 5%, what was the cost price of the article (in )?
solution:
**Given:**

Loss = 150

Loss% = 5%

**Formula used:**

Loss = (Loss% ÷ 100) × CP

**Calculations:**

⇒ 150 = (5 ÷ 100) × CP

⇒ CP = 150 ÷ 0.05

⇒ CP = 3000

**∴ Cost Price = 3000.**
